text: Purpose. WebGL point-cloud viewer box / lasso / polygon selection. viewer_cloud_source — "Full georeferenced LAS/LAZ/COPC sample" "PLY preview fallback" (default). viewer_max_points — decimation target. Default 50 000 PLY preview, configurable. show_orthomosaic_basemap — toggles ground-plane texture. show_dsm_drape — drapes DSM points. Outputs. point_cloud_three, viewer_basemap, selection events back R (selected_points). Point cloud sent packed Float32Array (binary) — inline JSON — 50 k points fit ~1 MB wire. LAS / LAZ / COPC paths use lidR::readLAS() PDAL push-filters: -keep_xy <bbox> (skips chunks outside active ROI COPC) -keep_random_fraction <f> (decoder-level decimation, post-load). PLY preview ODM point_cloud.ply; binary little-endian layout (x y z float32 + red blue green views uchar, 16 B/vertex) read one readBin() pass (R/pointcloud.R:28-117). LAS / LAZ / COPC: full sensor precision (LAS 1.2 / 1.4 XYZ int32 + scale/offset; cm-level typical drone surveys). PLY preview ODM: photogrammetric vertical RMSE ≈ 1.5–3 × GSD GCPs (Dandois & Ellis 2013, Remote Sens., https://doi.org/10.3390/rs5052572); without GCPs, vertical bias can tens cm m. Source.
